dataset.title: Gene essentiality (SGD)
dataset.description: Predict whether the null mutant of a gene is inviable. Both labels come from SGD: essential genes are those with a null mutant annotated inviable in S288C, non-essential genes those with a null mutant annotated viable. A prediction is a score, larger meaning more likely essential.
